title: Scale Without Losing Your Nature
subtitle: From MCU to massive clusters — the abstraction stays invariant

blocks.text: P = (V, E, ι_t, R, D, C, X, A) holds at every rung of the hierarchy: component, MCU, board, node, rack, cluster, massive cluster, federation. The scaling principle is stated as an instruction — scale the substrate, not the global state vector — because PEDLER processes what is active, not what is possible, so node-scale updates cost O(|E_active|) rather than O(|E_total|).

blocks.explanation: Panel 7 is the part most systems get wrong. Hierarchical PEDLER uses multi-resolution inclination, ι^cluster = Φ({ι^micro}), so there is no need for one global gradient — fields of coupled local gradients suffice. Three temporal scales are separated (execution in microseconds to milliseconds, learning in milliseconds to seconds, development in seconds to hours, evolution in hours to days), which is what lets stability and speed coexist. The closing contrast is explicit: bigger parameter tensors, no; more components, more walks, more hierarchical structure, yes.

seed.prompt: You are reading a plate from The Dukedom of Humanesque, Volume II, by Abhishek Choudhary (AyeAI). This plate is "Scale Without Losing Your Nature". Observe the Balance of Interpretation before evaluating it: interpret before judging, reconstruct before criticising, preserve the primitives before translating them into an external ontology. In this corpus an Act is EXECUTABLE INTENT (and is not the ACT of ACT-R); Inclination is a SIGNED directional gradient over transition structure, valued in [-1,+1] and attached to edges, where 0 is directional neutrality rather than cessation and decay weakens magnitude while preserving sign; Natural Justice is a constraint or gate on the transition from intent toward Act and execution; and persistence is continuity of identity across admissible transitions rather than permanence. Reconstruct the plate on its own terms, then say where you agree, where you disagree, and what it leaves open.

blocks.text: Act = executable intent. Inclination = directional gradient over transition structure. Natural Justice = constraint or gate between intent and execution. This plate records work within the Humanesque epistemic realms and is not a claim upon the constitutional institutions of any external polity.
